title: Normalized single tensor coefficient comparisons respect a coordinate square
statement: Use standard derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and the pinned single tensor comparison Q_a [lem-sc-picard-termwise-single-map-composition]. Let z:Z→W, q:X′→W, t:P→Z, i:J→W, r:J′→X′ and k:J′→J be scheme maps, with e:J≅Z and e′:J′≅P, and equalities e;z=i, k;e=e′;t, k;i=r;q. Let N be an O_W-module, M=T_z N, E=M[0], E′=(T_t M)[0], K=N[0], K′=(T_q N)[0], with literal tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write c for relativeMVComp [def-pc-relative-mv-maps] and C(a,b,d) for tensorPullbackCompositionIso from T_d to T_a T_b [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Set aN=C(e,z,i)⁻¹(N) and bN=C(e′,t,e′;t)⁻¹(M);C(e′;t,z,r;q)⁻¹(N);C(r,q,r;q)(N), using the displayed equalities. Suppose Q_r(T_q N) is invertible. For any alpha:L_e E→L_i K and beta:L_e′ E′→L_r K′ with alpha;Q_i(N)=Q_e(M);aN[0] and beta;Q_r(T_q N)=Q_e′(T_t M);bN[0], one has L_k(alpha);(c(k,i);transport(k;i=r;q);c(r,q)⁻¹;L_r(Q_q(N)))=c(k,e);transport(k;e=e′;t);c(e′,t)⁻¹;L_e′(Q_t(M));beta. This is solely a coefficient identity, with no direct image, base scheme or base-change mate.

proof.text: Postcompose with picardTermwiseSingleMap r (T_q N), which is invertible by the explicit hypothesis. Substitute the normalization equation for beta. Apply picardTermwiseSingleMap_composition to (r,q) and (k,i), expressing successive single comparisons using the selected derived and tensor composition maps. Substitute the normalization equation for alpha; naturality of the selected derived counit and the chain single comparison moves the single image of aN across the k comparison.

Apply the same single-comparison composition formula to (k,e.hom) and (e'.hom,t). The tensor composition factors on the two routes agree by tensorPullbackCompositionIso_associativity for (k,e.hom,z), and transport along ht identifies k;e with e';t. The equalities hi and hsq identify the total composite with r;q. Equality induction identifies the transports. The three factors defining bN are exactly the inverse composition factors followed by the r;q tensor composition. Reassociate, cancel the inverse derived composition factors, and cancel the postcomposed invertible r comparison. No single comparison for q or t is inverted.
